name: iaqualink-mcp
description: iAqualink (Zodiac/Jandy/Fluidra) pool equipment for Claude — read temperatures, pumps, heaters and chlorinator state, and switch equipment with confirmation

iaqualink_email.title: iAqualink email
iaqualink_email.description: The email address you sign in to the iAqualink app with (needed by every tool; the server starts without it and reports it missing on first use)

iaqualink_password.title: iAqualink password
iaqualink_password.description: Your iAqualink password (needed by every tool; the server starts without it and reports it missing on first use)

iaqualink_status_cache_seconds.title: Status cache (seconds)
iaqualink_status_cache_seconds.description: Seconds a system's status read is reused before re-polling iAqualink (default 5; 0 disables)

tools.name: iaqualink_list_systems
tools.description: List the pool/spa systems on the iAqualink account and their serial numbers

tools.name: iaqualink_get_status
tools.description: Pool, spa and air temperatures, set points, pumps, heaters, aux circuits, lights and chlorinator state

tools.name: iaqualink_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify the iAqualink sign-in: whether a credential resolved and whether iAqualink accepts it

tools.name: iaqualink_set_equipment
tools.description: Turn a pump, heater or eXO chlorinator function on or off (confirm-gated)

tools.name: iaqualink_set_aux
tools.description: Turn an aux circuit or light on or off (confirm-gated)

tools.name: iaqualink_set_light
tools.description: Set a light’s brightness or color effect (confirm-gated)

tools.name: iaqualink_set_temperature
tools.description: Set the pool and/or spa heater set point (confirm-gated)

tools.name: iaqualink_set_chlorinator
tools.description: Set an eXO salt chlorinator’s output percentage (confirm-gated)

tools.name: iaqualink_list_schedules
tools.description: List pool schedules: a Jandy AquaLink RS panel's own programs (via WebTouch, falling back to iQ20 schedules), or eXO pump/chlorinator/aux timers

tools.name: iaqualink_set_schedule
tools.description: Set, re-time or disable an eXO salt-chlorinator timer (start/stop, rpm for variable-speed pumps), with confirmation; eXO only

tools.name: iaqualink_list_onetouch
tools.description: List an AquaLink RS panel's OneTouch scenes (e.g. Spa Mode, All OFF) and whether each is on, via WebTouch

tools.name: iaqualink_set_onetouch
tools.description: Turn an AquaLink RS panel's OneTouch scene on or off via WebTouch, with confirmation

tools.name: iaqualink_add_schedule
tools.description: Add a program to an AquaLink RS panel's schedule via WebTouch (circuit, start, stop, run days), with confirmation and a verified re-read

tools.name: iaqualink_edit_schedule
tools.description: Change an RS panel program's start, stop or run days via WebTouch, with confirmation and a verified re-read

tools.name: iaqualink_delete_schedule
tools.description: Delete a program from an RS panel's schedule via WebTouch (no undo), with confirmation and a verified re-read
